record.question: Which of the following player won the Golden Shoe award for the fifth time?
record.explanation: Answer D: Lionel Messi. Lionel Messi received his fifth European Golden Shoe in December 2018 for his 2017–18 season, which matches the 2019-era source question. He later won a sixth for 2018–19; the answer is still Messi, with the fifth-award fact date-anchored. Reference: https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/actualites/947641/leo-messi-reoit-son-5me-soulier-dor-europen. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
